annotations.title: Monitor App Store and Google Play reviews

description: Return App Store and Google Play reviews for the apps you give, by country store, newest first. Give apps as App Store URLs or ids (id618783545) or Google Play URLs or package names (com.Slack). With a state_key, each run returns only reviews not returned by an earlier run with that key. Every review row carries stars, title, text, author, app version, date, helpful votes, the Google Play developer reply, and the developer name, website, and domain. One app_summary row per app and country store gives the app rating, rating count, change since the last run, and the star split of the new reviews. Google Play reviews are per language, so they come back once under the first country. Input with no app comes back as one free row with error_reason input_invalid. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per review row and per app trend row.

apps.description: One per line: an App Store URL (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/slack/id618783545), an App Store id (id618783545), a Google Play URL, or a Google Play package name (com.Slack). Up to 100 apps per run

countries.description: Two letter store codes, one per line, for example us, gb, de. Default us. Up to 10. App Store reviews are separate per country. Google Play shows the same reviews in every country for one language, so its reviews are returned once, under the first country, and each other country gets its own rating row

include_summary.description: Default true: one row per app and country store with the rating, rating count, change since the last run, and the stars of the new reviews

language.description: Language code for Google Play reviews and pages. Default en

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before it would charge more than this

max_reviews_per_app.description: Most reviews returned per app and country store in one run, newest first. Default 100. The App Store feed serves at most 500 per country; Google Play up to 2000

only_new.description: Default true. Each run remembers the reviews it returned, per app and country, under the state key

reset_state.description: true forgets the reviews returned before, so this run starts over

since.description: Optional. Only reviews on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD), or within this many days (30)

star_ratings.description: Optional. Only return reviews with these star ratings, for example 1 and 2 for complaints. Empty returns all

state_key.description: Names the saved state. Use one key per schedule, for example competitor-apps-daily

name: monitor_app_reviews
title: Monitor App Store and Google Play reviews
